jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform
for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers
, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining
Autodesk Operations Solutions
, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations.
Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineering Director to lead MaintainX's Platform division. Platform owns the seven foundational teams every product engineer builds on: AI Builder, DevOps, Compliance, Testing Frameworks, Backend Frameworks, Mobile Frameworks, and SRE. This is a manager-of-managers role for someone who wants to define how a high-growth engineering org operates at scale.

What You’ll Do

Own the roadmap and operating model for Platform Engineering: set division-level priorities, manage cross-team dependencies, and translate business goals into multi-quarter platform investments.
Lead and develop a team of Software Development Managers - coaching on people development, technical judgment, and organizational effectiveness across seven teams.
Set the engineering standards every product team depends on: framework conventions, reliability targets, compliance posture, and CI/CD health.
Drive MaintainX's AI-native platform strategy - the AI Builder team's agent orchestration, tool registry, and developer environments sit in this division; your job is to ensure the org extracts real leverage from them.
Own division-level reliability: SLO definitions, incident response frameworks, on-call health, and the systemic path from incident to prevention.
Partner with the CTO and peer engineering leaders on org design, architectural decisions, and headcount planning.
Represent Platform Engineering to the business — translating infrastructure investment into engineering velocity, developer experience, and customer trust.
An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis.

About You

10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years in engineering leadership, including 2+ years managing managers across multiple teams.
Technical depth in at least two of: distributed systems, backend or mobile frameworks, platform engineering, reliability engineering - credible enough to make hard hiring decisions and engage in architecture reviews.
Track record of owning platform or infrastructure-focused teams at a growth-stage B2B SaaS company, with demonstrated impact on engineering velocity.
AI-forward: you set direction for teams building on LLMs and agentic workflows, and you hold your org to an AI-native standard.
Systems thinker who identifies organizational bottlenecks and eliminates them without creating new ones — you design teams, not just manage them.
Strong communicator who can represent platform complexity and tradeoffs clearly to product, finance, and executive stakeholders.

Nice To Have

Experience leading a Testing Frameworks, Quality Engineering, or Developer Productivity platform function.
Hands-on history scaling developer platforms through rapid headcount growth (Series D+).
Familiarity with CMMS, IoT, or industrial SaaS domains.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running.
Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits.
Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging.
We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

Compensation Range: CA$173K - CA$254K

jobs.title: AVP, Technology Lead - Digital
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The AVP Technology Lead – Digital is a strategic technology leader responsible for enabling, scaling, and modernizing Sun Life Canada’s shared digital platforms that support secure, connected, and frictionless Client and advisor experiences. This role provides technology leadership across core digital assets including Secure Web, Public Web, & Secure Mobile, and related enablement platforms such as client identity and access management, and an internal design system.

The role combines strategic leadership, technical oversight, people leadership, delivery execution, operational accountability, and vendor/financial management to drive technology excellence and measurable business value. The AVP partners closely with Product, Client Experience, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Operations, Engineering, and Business leaders to ensure digital assets are resilient, scalable, secure, reusable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.

This role operates in a complex, high-visibility environment where digital platform reliability, modernization, and cross-business enablement are critical to Client outcomes. The leader must be able to bring clarity to a broad mandate, make decisions in ambiguity, and build a high-performing technology organization that balances speed, stability, security, and long-term platform health.

What will you do?

Technology Strategy, Platform Enablement & Engineering
Shape, communicate, and align the digital technology strategy across business units, ensuring it supports near-term delivery commitments and longer-term modernization objectives.
Partner with Business Leads, Product, Client Experience, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Operations, and Enterprise Technology to define platform roadmaps, OKRs, sequencing, and investment priorities.
Provide thought leadership on the evolution of shared digital platforms, including identity, web, mobile, integration, data enablement, and reusable digital capabilities.
Promote technology stack standards, modern engineering practices, automation, and architectural discipline, balancing build vs. buy vs. partner decisions in a complex technology ecosystem.
Ensure design and engineering decisions account for reusability, scalability, security, maintainability, accessibility, and technical debt reduction.
Create the conditions for exceptional digital experiences by enabling business and product teams with reliable, scalable, secure, and reusable platforms.
Platform Delivery & Execution
Accountable for end-to-end delivery of digital platform capabilities, including oversight of internal delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and total cost of ownership.
Drive delivery excellence by improving velocity, quality, reliability, predictability, and agile maturity across multiple squads.
Track delivery metrics, identify bottlenecks, and implement targeted productivity and delivery maturity improvements.
Serve as the primary escalation point for platform, delivery, vendor, and dependency-related issues, enabling rapid resolution in a complex environment.
Ensure delivery is integrated across product, architecture, engineering, operations, cybersecurity, and business priorities.
Embed test-and-learn, automation, and continuous improvement practices to improve speed, quality, and sustainability.
People Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor, and develop technology leaders and teams, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and execution-focused culture.
Design and optimize team structures to support clear ownership, delivery outcomes, modernization priorities, and clear accountabilities.
Partner with Chapter, Engineering, Product, and Business leaders on workforce planning, role clarity, succession planning, and capability development.
Build internal capability in digital engineering, enablement, agile delivery, vendor management, and operational excellence.
Coach leaders to manage performance effectively, clarify ownership, and build resilient teams through change and transformation.
Financial & Vendor Management
Lead budget management, including annual planning, cost tracking, capitalization, forecasting, and investment prioritization.
Manage strategic vendor and system integrator relationships, holding partners accountable for delivery quality, outcomes, knowledge transfer, and value realization.
Drive cost transparency and technology spend optimization across applications, infrastructure, security, vendor, and platform investments.
Identify opportunities to reduce long-term dependency on external partners while strengthening internal platform ownership and capability.
Operational Excellence, Risk & Security
Ensure stability, security, technology currency, resiliency, and end-of-life decommissioning for applications within scope.
Establish governance processes that balance speed of delivery with risk management, audit, regulatory, cybersecurity, and control requirements.
Partner with Application Operations to ensure effective incident management, change management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Proactively manage operational risk, application health, technical debt, and service reliability across shared digital capabilities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a strategic technology partner to leaders across Product, Client Experience, Business, Operations, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Technology.
Communicate digital strategy, delivery status, risks, trade-offs, and dependencies with clarity and transparency.
Represent the Digital technology function in executive forums, bringing enterprise perspective, external insight, and pragmatic recommendations.
Strengthen alignment between technology investments, business priorities, Client experience outcomes, and enterprise digital strategy.

Accountabilities

Align digital strategy with business objectives, Client outcomes, enterprise standards, and shared technology priorities.
Define and monitor roadmaps, OKRs, modernization priorities, and delivery sequencing.
Oversee execution across delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and enterprise partners.
Establish governance, track delivery metrics, and drive productivity, quality, and reliability improvements.
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, and cost optimization opportunities.
Build and sustain a high-performing, engaged, inclusive, and platform-oriented technology organization.
Ensure digital platforms are secure, scalable, resilient, reusable, and positioned to support future growth.

What you need to succeed?

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree or MBA is an asset.
10+ years of experience in senior technology leadership roles with demonstrated success delivering complex, mission-critical digital platforms.
Experience leading modernization and enablement of digital platforms such as identity, web, mobile, integration, or client/advisor experience platforms.
Proven ability to lead technology teams through transformation, platform ownership, and operating model evolution.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing sizable technology budgets, vendor portfolios, and total cost of ownership.
Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, and organizational leadership skills.
Experience in regulated financial services is valuable; depth in digital enablement, engineering excellence, and vendor-heavy delivery environments is prioritized.
As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only for the frequent interactions with English and French-speaking colleagues or internal partners across Canada or worldwide

Mindset & Behaviours

Decisive leader comfortable operating in ambiguity, complexity, and transformation.
Strong technical credibility with the ability to challenge architecture, delivery practices, platform decisions, and CI/CD approaches.
Builder mindset with equal focus on fixing, scaling, enabling, and simplifying.
Pragmatic, outcomes-driven decision-maker who balances speed, stability, risk, and long-term application health.
Collaborative leader who builds trust, drives momentum, and creates clarity across complex stakeholder groups.
Critical thinker who challenges the status quo constructively and drives continuous improvement.
Strong coaching orientation with a commitment to developing leaders, teams, and internal capability.

What’s in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
Time off that allows you to focus on the moments that matter most. 20 vacation days per year.
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.
A warm, supportive, and inclusive culture.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

165,000/165 000 - 235,000/235 000

jobs.title: National Director, Information Technology
jobs.description:
We’re excited to share that JDRF Canada is now Breakthrough T1D.

We’re the same organization, with the same mission and determination to realize a world free from type 1 diabetes (T1D) – just with a new name and look that reflects what the T1D community needs now and next.

It’s an exciting time to join Breakthrough T1D as we continue to break barriers to help people better manage the disease and enjoy full, healthy lives. Curing T1D is and always will be our north star and we will not stop until breakthroughs get us to a world free from T1D.

Breakthrough T1D is searching for an experienced leader in Information Technology for the role of National Director, Information Technology.

If you’re a strategic, innovative and collaborative leader who would like to lead the next chapter of the organization’s digital evolution by developing and delivering a multi-year information technology strategy, roadmap and portfolio aligned with Breakthrough T1D’s strategic priorities, please read on to see if this is the right fit for you.

Here’s what your primary responsibilities would be:

Works with the Senior Leadership Team to develop and execute a multi-year IT and digital strategy, roadmap and investment portfolio aligned with organizational priorities and supported by business cases, resource plans, budgets, performance measures and clear accountabilities.
Leads Breakthrough T1D’s responsible AI strategy and portfolio, including governance, approved-use standards, privacy and security controls, vendor due diligence, human oversight, staff education, prioritized use cases and benefits measurement.
Provides planning, resourcing, oversight and accountability for the IT portfolio, including enterprise applications, infrastructure, digital platforms, data and analytics, cybersecurity, service delivery and technology-enabled innovation.
Partners with business leaders to assess needs, select solutions and oversee the design, implementation and integration of technologies that support mission delivery, research collaboration, fundraising, advocacy and organizational operations.
Develops, implements and maintains Breakthrough T1D’s cybersecurity framework, policies and controls, aligned with organizational risk, privacy and data sovereignty requirements and applicable standards.
Leads the enterprise data and analytics strategy, including data ownership, quality, classification, integration, retention, privacy, governance, reporting and the development of trusted organizational and constituent insights.
Builds, motivates and retains a highly engaged, customer-centred information technology team aligned with Breakthrough T1D’s values, vision and strategic priorities.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Knowledge/Skills/Experience
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, business technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
A minimum of seven (7) years of progressive leadership experience across information technology, digital transformation, project and portfolio management, enterprise applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and service delivery, including experience leading complex enterprise-wide initiatives and multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrated experience managing IT environments with cybersecurity, privacy, and data sovereignty requirements comparable to those of federally Canadian organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise digital transformation involving cloud platforms, enterprise architecture, systems integration, digital products, vendor ecosystems and organizational change.

Working Style
Applies sound judgment, initiative and a strong sense of organization and urgency in a changing environment.
Communicates complex information clearly and credibly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, senior executives and governance bodies.
Demonstrates strong business analysis, project and financial management capabilities and a record of leading successful cross-functional initiatives.
Builds trusted relationships through a collaborative, customer-centred and business-focused approach.

Other position requirements to note:
Demonstrated experience overseeing high-volume transactional websites, CRM platforms, digital fundraising or engagement solutions, and internal collaboration and information-sharing platforms; experience with not-for-profit enterprise systems is an asset.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, data sovereignty, records and information management, accessibility, responsible AI, cyber resilience and third-party technology risk in a Canadian context.
Project, program, technology governance, security or service management certification is an asset.
Translates organizational strategy and stakeholder needs into practical technology priorities, investment decisions and outcomes.

The salary range for this role is anticipated to be $125,000 - $160,000, commensurate with skills and experience level of the selected candidate.

Location Preference:
Anywhere within Canada

About Breakthrough T1D

Breakthrough T1D is the leading type 1 diabetes (T1D) research and advocacy non-profit organization in Canada. As we drive toward curing type 1 diabetes, we help to make every day better for the people who live with it.

Breakthrough T1D (formerly JDRF) began in Canada as a grassroots organization in 1974, when a group of dedicated parents came together with a singular goal of finding a cure for T1D. Since the discovery of insulin, Breakthrough T1D has remained at the forefront of T1D research. Breakthrough T1D is committed to investing in the most promising research, advocating for progress by working with governments to address issues that impact the T1D community, and supporting individuals living with this disease.

Breakthrough T1D has a company culture rooted in our Core Values; Adapt and Thrive, Collaborate, Accountable, Innovate, Act with Purpose – if our core values are exemplified in the way that you work, we might be a great fit for each other.

Here’s a few details about what Breakthrough T1D employees receive:

Remote-first:
Our employees love the convenience and flexibility of working remotely, so all positions are work from home (within Canada).
Health and Wellness Benefits:
Benefits to support your physical and mental health – this includes Manulife group benefits, Maple virtual health care, Not Myself Today to support mentally healthy workplaces and generous paid sick time.
Professional Development:
We want employees to grow within their roles and have a career at Breakthrough T1D, so we practice Career Development Planning and have a budget for paid development opportunities for each employee.
Other benefits include:
Group RRSP Matching Program, winter holiday office closures, flex weeks in the summer and more!

Benefits listed above for regular full-time employees. Not all benefits may be available to part-time or temporary employees.

Recruitment Process: We may review applications as they are received and this position will remain posted until it is filled. Our recruitment process typically includes an initial introductory phone call with an HR team member, and up to two video interviews over MS Teams with the hiring manager and other members of the team. Some positions may require a skills-based evaluation to be completed as a part of the recruitment process. We thank all those applicants that apply, but please note only those selected for an introductory phone call will be contacted after their application is submitted.

Breakthrough T1D strives to foster a workplace that reflects the diversity of the community it serves and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. Breakthrough T1D is also committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free selection process and work environment. Please advise if you require any accommodation measures to ensure you will be interviewed in a fair and equitable manner. Information received relating to accommodation requests will be treated with confidentiality.

jobs.title: Director, Planning, Procurement & Inventory
jobs.description:
Imagine yourself…

Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project.
Owning your ambition and fueling your career growth.

At Trojan Technologies, you have the power to make it possible.

Trojan Technologies, a Veralto company, plays a vital role in making the various stages of the water treatment process more effective and efficient. Our products and services have applications across municipal wastewater, drinking water, environmental contaminant treatment, and residential water treatment, along with ultra-purification of water used in food and beverage manufacturing, pharmaceutical processing and semiconductor applications.

When you join the Trojan Technologies team and the broader Veralto network, you become part of a unique culture where purpose meets possibility: where the work we do makes an everyday impact on the world’s vital water resources, and where you’ll have the power to deepen your skillset, own your ambition, and fuel your career growth.

Take a moment to watch our video: The Power to Make Things Possible (https://vimeo.com/burnsmarketing/review/823050239/c5d19b300c)

We are seeking a Director, Planning, Procurement & Inventory to lead the enterprise function that turns customer demand into a credible, executable supply plan, secures material availability, and optimizes inventory across regions and fulfilment models.

This is an opportunity to bring Demand Planning, Supply and Production Planning, Tactical Procurement, and Inventory into one connected operating model. You will lead through significant organizational and ERP-enabled change while improving customer service and working capital together.

This position is located in London, Ontario, and will be onsite.

What You Will Do

Lead enterprise planning and SIOP. Own demand planning, forecasting, executive SIOP, the approved enterprise supply plan, planning risk, and cross-functional escalation across regions and businesses.
Strengthen supply and production planning. Lead master production scheduling, MRP, material-availability management, shortage recovery, and planning logic across Make-to-Stock, Engineer-to-Order, Configure-to-Order, and aftermarket flows.
Direct tactical procurement and inventory governance. Lead tactical buying, supplier-delivery performance, purchasing master data, inventory strategy, service-level policy, E&O governance, record accuracy, and inventory improvement.
Own Procurement Planning & inventory business processes through ERP transformation. Lead relevant Order-to-Cash and Procure-to-Pay workstreams from design and testing through cutover, adoption, stabilization, process governance, and master-data health.
Build one capable enterprise organization. Establish a common KPI architecture, management cadence, decision rights, standard work, talent development, succession coverage, and an everyday continuous-improvement operating system.

The essential requirements of the job include:

A bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field.
Progressive leadership of enterprise planning, tactical procurement, and inventory in a complex manufacturing environment.
Demonstrated leadership across a combination of Make-to-Stock, Engineer-to-Order, Configure-to-Order, and aftermarket or service-parts planning.
Direct ownership of Demand Planning and an executive S&OP or SIOP process that drove cross-functional decisions.

Vice President of Finance

Investment Management, Private Equity, PropTech, SaaS (Software as a Service), Technology

Full-Time

This is a remote position; however, candidates must be located in the same country, city, or region where the job is posted. The successful candidate must be available to attend a local office, meeting, training session, or company event if requested.

Please only apply if you are based in the location listed on this job posting. Remote does not mean the position is open worldwide.

Compensation:
C$180,000–C$200,000 base salary
, based on experience, plus a performance-based annual bonus targeted at 15%–20% of base salary

Build Financial Clarity Across a Growing Group of Companies

Rothenbury Group
owns and operates technology-enabled businesses across real estate, property management, brokerage, leasing, maintenance, staffing, media, and other service industries.

We are hiring an experienced Vice President of Finance
to strengthen financial reporting, cash-flow visibility, forecasting, controls, documentation, and executive decision support across the group.

This is a senior finance leadership role for someone who can enter a complex, multi-company environment, assess the current state of financial information, identify gaps and risks, establish priorities, and provide management with clear, practical recommendations.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior leadership while coordinating with internal finance staff, accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and other external partners.

Our Hiring Process

Please apply with your resume and a brief summary of your senior finance experience.

If your background aligns with the role, you will receive an email within 24 to 48 hours of applying
with a link to complete a pre-recorded online interview
.

The interview will help us better understand your finance leadership background, technical capabilities, reporting approach, judgment, and experience working with complex financial information. Selected candidates will then be invited to continue through the next stage of the interview process.

Your Mandate

The Vice President of Finance will be responsible for creating greater visibility, organization, accuracy, and accountability across the group’s financial operations.

You Will Be Expected To

Assess the condition of financial records, reporting processes, controls, and supporting documentation
Identify missing information, unexplained balances, inconsistencies, financial risks, process gaps, and priority action items
Improve cash-flow visibility, budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and management reporting
Build clear reporting structures that help leadership understand performance, obligations, risks, and upcoming decisions
Strengthen reconciliations, approval processes, internal controls, and finance operating discipline
Coordinate effectively with internal teams and external financial, legal, tax, banking, and advisory partners
Provide practical recommendations that support immediate decisions and long-term financial improvement

Key Responsibilities

Review, organize, analyze, summarize, and reconcile financial and accounting information across multiple companies
Review banking, payroll, tax, ownership, investment, corporate, vendor, client, receivable, payable, budgeting, and forecasting records
Prepare executive summaries, management reports, financial models, dashboards, schedules, trackers, reconciliations, workpapers, and memoranda
Develop clear reporting on cash position, cash-flow requirements, expenses, receivables, payables, budgets, forecasts, and financial risks
Identify incomplete records, unexplained transactions, reporting weaknesses, control concerns, and process failures
Improve finance-related document organization, file structures, naming conventions, supporting records, and document readiness
Strengthen month-end, reconciliation, and management-reporting processes
Support budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, financial modelling, and operational finance planning
Review and improve internal controls, approval workflows, finance policies, and accountability standards
Coordinate with accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and other external partners
Clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, unresolved questions, risks, recommendations, and required next steps
Support financial clean-up projects, transitions, system changes, special reviews, and other senior finance initiatives
Provide senior leadership with accurate, timely, and decision-ready financial information

Required Experience And Qualifications

The successful candidate will have:

10+ years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, controllership, FP&A, corporate finance, or senior financial management
At least 5 years in a senior finance leadership position, such as Vice President of Finance, Director of Finance, Controller, Head of Finance, or an equivalent role
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field
A CPA, CA, CMA, CGA, MBA, or comparable senior finance qualification is strongly preferred
Strong experience reviewing complex financial records, reports, reconciliations, budgets, forecasts, and supporting documentation
Advanced understanding of financial reporting, cash-flow management, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, and finance operations
Experience preparing executive-level reports, dashboards, financial models, trackers, memoranda, and management updates
Strong ability to identify financial gaps, inconsistencies, control weaknesses, process issues, and business risks
Experience working with accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and executive stakeholders
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial modelling, reconciliations, reporting, and structured data analysis
Experience using accounting systems and managing information related to banking, payroll, receivables, payables, vendors, clients, budgets, forecasts, and corporate records
Excellent written communication, documentation, and presentation skills
Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and attention to detail
Ability to manage evolving priorities and provide clear recommendations with limited supervision

Experience That Will Stand Out

Preference May Be Given To Candidates With

Experience overseeing finance across multiple companies, entities, business units, or operating divisions
Real estate accounting or finance experience
Property management accounting experience
Asset management or development accounting experience
Experience working in a founder-led, entrepreneurial, or rapidly growing organization
Experience improving an existing finance function rather than only maintaining established systems
Experience strengthening reporting, financial controls, documentation, systems, or cash-flow visibility during a period of growth or transition
Experience combining strategic finance leadership with hands-on financial review and problem-solving

The Leader Who Will Succeed Here

The right person is highly analytical but also practical.

They can review a large volume of financial information, determine what is reliable, identify what is missing, and separate immediate financial risks from lower-priority clean-up work. They are comfortable working with senior management and can explain complex financial matters clearly and directly.

They do not simply identify problems. They organize the work, establish priorities, recommend solutions, and create the reporting and financial discipline required to support better decisions.

They are equally comfortable reviewing detailed reconciliations, preparing executive reporting, coordinating with external advisors, and advising leadership on financial priorities.

What Success Looks Like

Success In This Role Will Mean

Leadership has clearer and more reliable visibility into the financial position of the group
Cash-flow requirements, financial obligations, risks, and upcoming decisions are easier to understand
Financial records and supporting documentation are organized, complete, and decision-ready
Management reporting is timely, accurate, and useful
Reconciliations, controls, approvals, and finance processes operate with greater discipline
Missing information and unresolved financial issues are identified and assigned clear next steps
Accountants, bookkeepers, advisors, and internal teams operate with stronger structure and accountability
The finance function becomes more scalable as Rothenbury Group continues to grow

Compensation and Opportunity

The base salary range for this position is C$180,000–C$200,000
, based on the candidate’s finance leadership experience, professional designation, multi-company background, technical capabilities, industry exposure, and overall fit.

The Successful Candidate Will Also Be Eligible For a Performance-based Annual Bonus Targeted At 15%–20% Of Base Salary. Bonus Performance May Be Assessed Using Factors Such As

Financial reporting accuracy and timeliness
Cash-flow visibility and forecasting quality
Strength of financial controls
Completion of reconciliations and financial clean-up priorities
Improvement in management reporting
Finance-process discipline
Quality of executive decision support
Progress in building a scalable and accountable finance function

This is an opportunity to take on a senior finance leadership position with meaningful influence across a diverse and growing group of businesses.

You will lead and mentor a team of high performing data scientists and shape our growth strategy through empirical studies and experimentation. This role is resourceful, analytically rigorous, with extensive experience leading data science teams and a passion for solving product problems.

This role is a mix of consulting know-how (problem solving, thought leadership, communication), analytical proficiency in statistics, data science and machine learning, agentic workflows, and, when required, hands-on proficiency in SQL/Python programming, visualization methods and technologies, and data engineering / infrastructure.

This role is responsible for leveraging data science to assess risks, improve underwriting, detect fraud, and optimize pricing models while unlocking valuable insights, optimize processes, and inform decision-making. By implementing advanced analytics and ensuring data integrity, this role enables the organization to make informed decisions, streamline operations, and ultimately provide better coverage and services to policyholders while managing risks effectively.

What will you do :

Managing a data science project from end-to-end, including collaborating with partners and stakeholders to understand the business problem, obtaining data, defining an experimental design, setting up a model building pipeline, overseeing a team of data scientists to build necessary models, and working with a team of developers to implement models and managing a monitoring process
Developing and maintaining predictive models using advanced ML/AI techniques. Building Supervised and unsupervised learning models LLM workflows and agents.
overseeing the development of analytical products and machine learning models, AI models, LLM workflows and agents, building and enabling analytics infrastructure including production model deployment, as well as Non Prod experimentation, deployment and testing
Define metrics to measure the impact of AI initiatives on business outcomes.

Design detailed validation plans and perform quantitative, conceptual and technical assessment of models; Discuss and effectively communicate validation observations and findings with teams.
Accountable for the integration of AI solutions, application deployment in production including, app health, resiliency, performance, security, enterprise data management standards, ethical and privacy standards
Continuously monitor and improve the performance of AI models, ensuring their accuracy, reliability, scalability, and ethical application. Includes optimization of our end-to-end machine learning pipelines, scaling, automating, and monitoring our predictive models and pipelines.
Strategic direction on compliance for the design, development, and implementation of AI models into operational workflows, including helping draft and review the procedures that support a compliance system. Responsibilities include guiding AI teams with project planning, system architecture, risk management, verification & validation, and continuous monitoring.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Lead a team of data scientists to develop, plan, and execute multiple analytical projects creating and delivering high quality AI and analytical solutions across a broad spectrum of projects and business lines.
Being a change champion and help the business conduct business problem opportunities and assessment identifying revenue generation and cost saving opportunities, developing proposals and make recommendations for model usage to the downstream partners.
Advocates and advances modern, Agile solution delivery practices, great design, engineering and organizational practices, challenging the team to utilize creative thinking to modify or select the most suitable procedure/approach to solve a business problem balancing complexity and value.
Driving change within team and across broader Data & Analytics the importance of learning our business and the respective to help aid in our building the best solutions – be a business expert.
Guide project teams in synthesizing analytical findings for consumption by internal analytical clients and business executives.Excellent communicator who is able to convey complex information in an understandable, compelling, and persuasive manner to non-technical clients and executives and junior data scientists

Strategy

Creates the advanced analytics strategy, ensuring technology solutions comply with enterprise AI/ML standards, model governance and model risk standards, and AI Ethics, Fairness and Bias related control practices
Conceptualize, design and execute an ambitious data science, ML and AI (e.g., LLM and agentic) roadmap
Own the business outcomes, KPIs and deliverables of that roadmap working across stakeholders
Identify and define new strategic ML opportunities and work with cross functional teams to understand business requirements and guide the team to provide data-driven solutions, improving how we do data collection, storage, experimentation and analysis.

Research & Innovation

Stay current with the latest advancements in Agentic/AI/ML solutions and evaluate their applicability to Gore
Develop strategic relationships and partnerships with the startup, academia, and industry ecosystem to garner mindshare and learnings.
Foster a culture of innovation by encouraging research, experimentation and exploration of novel AI techniques

What skills will you need:

Minimum Master’s degree, Ph.D. Highly preferred in a technology/analytical field such as Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science, Operations Research, Machine Learning, Engineering, or other relevant scientific fields
Over 10 years of expereince with a minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience, 4+ years of leading a team in developing and implementing AI/ML solutions (predictive, prescriptive, ML etc.)with an excellent understanding of the underlying Statistical, Machine Learning theory, and Predictive Modeling Lifecycle
Extensive experience in building, deploying, and managing production-ready generative models and machine learning models.
Foundational and applied knowledge of statistical analyses, data science, and machine learning including, but not limited to descriptive, inferential, or causal statistics, predictive and forecast modeling, optimization modeling, NLP, LLM and agentic workflows and A/B testing methods
Deep expertise in developing and maintaining predictive models using advanced ML/AI techniques. Proficiency in building Supervised learning models [ (classification and regression) – tree-based (Random Forest, Stochastic Gradient Boosting and eXtreme Gradient Boosting, Decision Trees, Extra Trees, Regularized Greedy Forests), Generalized Linear Models, Discriminant models (LDA, MDA, FDA and QDA)], and Unsupervised learning models (Isolation Forest, Clustering algorithms), Reinforcement learning, LLMs, agentic systems, graph and network analysis
Deep knowledge and hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AgenticAI, including experience with MLOps to build end-to-end pipelines and deploy models in production
Experience in building Deep neural networks (MLP, CNN, RNN, GRUs, and LSTMs) and use of AI/Deep Learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, CNTK, and Keras
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Pandas, Numpy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch etc.
Excellent problem-solving skills, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to challenges.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to a non-technical audience and influence top-tier executives. Proven ability to translate complex data findings into actionable business strategies and drive business growth
Deep understanding of the complexities and tradeoffs of leveraging/deploying ML/AI at scale
An ideal candidate will have a passion for AI/ML and to foster a team of AI/ML and business experts and increase the data and analytics literacy with the business. They have an analytical mindset, be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, detail oriented and have desire to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment while influencing business performance through insights.
